name: id
description: The ID of the error summary.

name: heading
description: Heading of the error summary component.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text for the heading. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML for the heading. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the heading.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the heading.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text to use for the description of the errors. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML to use for the description of the errors. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the error summary body.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the error summary body.

name: caller
description: Not strictly an option but supports the [`call` block](https://mozilla.github.io/nunjucks/templating.html#call) as an alternative to the `html` option. To use it, you will need to wrap the entire error summary component in a `call` block.

name: errorList
description: A list of errors to include in the error summary.

params.name: href
params.description: The error `href` attribute. If set, the error will become a link.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text for the error link item. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML for the error link item. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the error link.

name: disableAutoFocus
description: Prevent moving focus to the error summary when the page loads.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the error-summary container.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the error-summary container.
